manifest.test_set_note: 64 new complete claims, 32 independently constructed state/window scenarios. The two concise English rendering templates and marked syntax are fixed to the source. Novelty is in new interval worlds, including nesting, abutment, clipping and exact absence/full-window cases, not renamed source worlds. Template variants are not a natural-use sample or independent semantic frames.

shared_context.availability_to_arms: Identical complete reference ledger supplied before either claim; only the complete claim sentence is counted, as in the source.
shared_context.semantics: time-total is sum of merged/clipped true intervals; longest-stretch is their maximum duration; zero for established absence. Synthetic specified state only, not real-world availability or permission.
